tasks.short: Supervise student teaching, internship and research work

steps.what: Review the student's actual lesson plan, internship work or research draft against the agreed goals
inputs: student's actual work and agreed supervision goals
existing relevant work versions and supervisor comments
outputs: teacher-read student work and supervision issues

steps.what: Observe the student's actual teaching, internship activity or research practice where the supervision requires observation
inputs: actual student activity and agreed goals
teacher-read student work and supervision issues

steps.what: Discuss the student's work, give actual feedback and agree the next teaching, internship or research work
inputs: teacher-read student work and supervision issues
teacher's actual student-work observations
student's actual explanation and questions
outputs: actual supervision feedback and agreed next work

steps.what: Complete and check the actual written supervision feedback or required progress entry
inputs: actual supervision feedback and agreed next work
actual supervision record requirements

steps.what: Save the completed checked supervision feedback entry in the existing student workspace
inputs: complete checked supervision feedback entry

tasks.design: Configure a native student-work/version view across {LMS} and {DOCS}. The teacher still evaluates actual work, observes practice and gives feedback, then completes any actual required written entry before saving it; the change only removes repeated work-version navigation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Supervision can require locating current work among earlier versions and comments.
tasks.enabler_now: Native work/version views can expose the existing evidence together.
tasks.still_hard: The student's development and actual practice require contextual feedback.
tasks.human_edge: Choose the next challenge that helps the student develop independent teaching or research judgment.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native student-work/version views can reduce navigation while supervision observation and feedback remain human.

assumptions: Shares are an unmeasured supervision episode with an actual required written feedback entry; no report is assumed for every conversation.
Students supply their actual work; existing programme records supply goals and requirements. Missing versions are requested, not inferred.
Only source/version navigation changes. Observation, discussion and the actual written feedback remain fully retained.
Gross provisional saving 1.75 minus 0.5 hour of view/link upkeep gives 1.25 net; existing equivalent views remove the gain. Save is negligible and earns no saving.
unknowns: Actual written-feedback requirements and current work views
research_questions: Does supervision involve repeated work-version navigation that native views can remove?

already_counted.description: Read the actual student work and prior comments

incremental.description: Maintain student-work view and permission links

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 1.25%; substantive supervision remains unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop and maintain teaching Web pages

steps.what: Identify the actual teaching-page changes, current course facts and permitted source materials
inputs: actual course requirements and existing page
current course facts and permitted texts/media
outputs: teacher's actual page-change brief and source content

steps.what: Develop or update the actual teaching Web page, links, language content and media placement
inputs: teacher's actual page-change brief and source content
existing approved page components

steps.what: Check the complete page preview for language accuracy, course facts, working links, keyboard access and appropriate text/media alternatives
inputs: complete teaching-page preview version
teacher's actual page-change brief and source content
outputs: complete checked teaching-page version and intended audience

steps.what: Publish the exact checked teaching-page version to its intended audience
inputs: complete checked teaching-page version and intended audience

tasks.design: Configure existing approved course-page components and reusable link/media fields in {CMS}. The teacher supplies actual content, checks the full preview including language and access needs, then publishes that exact version through the separate publication action.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated page layout and link/media placement can require manual assembly.
tasks.enabler_now: Native page components can reuse approved layout without generating language or literary content.
tasks.still_hard: Correct facts, usable media and accessible language presentation require review of the actual page.
tasks.human_edge: Choose the content and presentation that serve the course's learners.

ambition.what: No new public content service assumed.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-4 for CMS publishing rights and material permissions

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native CMS components can reduce repeated teaching-page assembly while teachers check content and approve the actual publication version.

assumptions: Shares are provisional and unmeasured. Only actual repeated layout/link/media assembly changes; substantive content and preview checks remain.
The teacher produces the change brief in s1 from existing course records and permitted materials. No missing timetable, translation or media description is inferred.
Existing equivalent components remove the corresponding gain; no custom site build is assumed before native configuration is tested.
Gross provisional saving 17.7 minus 2 hours of component/link upkeep gives 15.7 net. The publish click is negligible and fully retained.
Any change after preview checking invalidates the publication gate. No automatic student notification is hidden in the design.
unknowns: Current CMS components and actual page-maintenance effort
research_questions: Which real page updates still repeat assembly that native approved components can remove?

already_counted.description: Complete remaining page editing and check the full publication preview

incremental.description: Maintain components, links and media-field configuration

approvals.approved_version: complete checked teaching-page version and intended audience

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 15.7%; existing native components may already remove the assembly work.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Read the student officers' actual activity question and relevant existing institutional guidance
inputs: student officers' actual activity question
existing organization guidance

steps.what: Advise the student officers on their actual organization's plans and concerns through discussion
inputs: teacher-read organization question and guidance
student officers' actual preferences and questions

tasks.design: Retain organization advising with the teacher. Actual guidance lookup is separate and already uses {DOCS}; the task alone establishes no additional retrieval change.
tasks.previous_blocker: Advice depends on what the officers are actually trying to do.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing guidance already supports the lookup; no new mechanism is established.
tasks.still_hard: Students need contextual advice while retaining responsibility for their own organization.
tasks.human_edge: Help officers consider cultural, academic and practical consequences of their plans.

ambition.what: No additional organizations or approval powers assumed.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: student-organization advising depends on actual officer questions and contextual discussion.

assumptions: Shares are illustrative and unmeasured. Actual proposal/guidance reading is separated from discussion and remains unchanged.
No report, approval instrument or send is established by this advising statement; none is invented.
There is no new structured input requirement, software change or upkeep. Gross/net saving are zero.
unknowns: Actual advising issues and retrieval friction
research_questions: Do observed advising cases reveal repeated retrieval or actual written follow-up that needs its own design?

incremental.description: No new system or process proposed

time_saved_range_pct.basis: No supported change to actual guidance reading or advising conversation.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Write proposals for external research funding

steps.what: Read the actual funding call, eligibility criteria and proposal requirements
inputs: actual funding call and application instructions

steps.what: Develop the actual language/literature research contribution, methods, source access plan, work programme and justified resources
inputs: teacher-checked grant requirements
actual research knowledge, source access and institutional resource rates
outputs: teacher's substantive research plan and checked resource proposal

steps.what: Write and check the actual grant proposal narrative, research references and required institutional fields
inputs: teacher's substantive research plan and checked resource proposal
teacher-checked grant requirements
existing institutional profile and actual publication metadata

steps.what: Save the completed checked grant proposal in the existing research workspace
inputs: complete checked language/literature grant proposal

tasks.design: Configure the existing funder-format template in {DOCS} to reuse actual institutional profile fields and verified publication metadata. The teacher develops and writes the research argument and checks the complete proposal before saving it; no external submission is automated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Fixed profile, publication and formatting fields can be re-entered during proposal writing.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document templates and metadata fields can reuse existing factual content.
tasks.still_hard: Research originality, source access, feasibility and budget justification require substantive judgment.
tasks.human_edge: Explain why the actual language or literature research deserves support.

ambition.what: No extra applications or funding outcome claimed.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-4 for profile access and permitted proposal processing

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native proposal templates can reuse verified institutional and publication fields while researchers retain the substantive grant argument.

assumptions: Shares are provisional and unmeasured. OTHER means funding-call resources, read only; existing spreadsheet formulas are already today's means and earn no new saving.

Institutional administrators maintain profile fields/rates; publishers and the teacher's existing records supply actual publication metadata. s2 creates the research plan; missing facts remain manual.
Only fixed-field reuse and formatting change. No model invents research, references, participant consent or project commitments.
Gross provisional saving 6.6 minus 1 hour of template/profile-field upkeep gives 5.6 net. Existing equivalent templates remove the gain.
Save is negligible and fully retained. Institutional approval and submission follow proposal writing and are not automated or credited here.
unknowns: Current template coverage and repeated factual field entry
research_questions: Which actual grant proposals still repeat fixed profile/reference fields after native templates are credited?

already_counted.description: Write and check the actual research narrative and completed proposal

incremental.description: Maintain funder templates and factual profile/reference mappings

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 5.6%; substantive research development and narrative writing remain fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.ambitious_version: Reduce repeated work-version navigation and document/page assembly while retaining supervision, student advising and research judgment.
